_comment: The rules of the game (services/Game). Draft numbers — tune freely, no code needed. order: the nine circles from the top down (story/circles.json). The circle a fall begins in: the heaviest sin among the circles no fall has begun in yet (all at zero: limbo); then all nine are open again. attempt: the minutes between tries to get out (each try is a trial scene in the circle — story/scenes, trigger "trial"); pactAfter: from this many failed tries in one circle the trial offers the pact; limboAfter: trials answered with silence (this fall) before the player sinks into the limbo outcome; limboReturn: minutes away from the computer (locked, asleep) before the angel finds them in limbo. actions: what the player does outside the scenes and which sin it weighs ({set} like a scene's, `every`: at most once per that many minutes; `realm`: only in heaven or hell).

pace._comment: Heaven ⇄ hell, the shows. quickSwitch: seconds — a switch this soon after the last one is instant: no circle splash, no quake, no breaking glass, no sound (someone clicking back and forth). soundGap: seconds between two plays of the same transition sound (the blow, the rocks, the glass, the choir) — they never pile up.

angel._comment: How the angel cools towards the player (services/Story → angelStep): every throw into hell adds its `chill` (actions below), and she is a step colder when she comes back — steps: chill from which she is reserved, cool, and cold (the cold route: from then on for good, until `angelos game reset`). thawHours: a day without a throw gives one step back (not out of the cold route). The player sees no number anywhere: only how she talks (story/angel.json) and her cursor.

fallen._comment: Her step past cold (Story → angelStep 4, "fallen"). A fall into hell that begins while she is already on the cold route (coldRoute: true), or after more than `moreThan` betrayals — the actions in `betrayal` — marks the trip; when the player comes back from it, she has changed: from then on for good, until `angelos game reset`. She shows as `look` whatever look Settings pick (the pick is kept), speaks in her broken voice, cries, and talks by herself oftener — her timer × `talkEvery` (not in calm motion). Her lines: story/angel.json → fallen. Nothing on screen counts or hints at any of it.

closeness._comment: Each circle's demon and the player (services/Story → closeness): her own count of points, in the save (hell.close). steps: the points from which she is acquainted, close, and your own (0 below: a stranger); each step up plays her scene (story/scenes, trigger "close", cond circle and closeness). The actions are demon.talk, demon.gift, demon.stay below — close: points, every: minutes between two of them (with her), sin: the gift feeds her circle's sin, costsTry: staying puts off the next try to get out. gifts: what her sin loves, the gift button's word. Her lines for them: story/voices.json → demons.

demon.talk.note: “Talk” in the demon's menu: a word with her

demon.gift.note: a gift her sin loves: closer, and the circle's sin +1

demon.stay.note: stay in her circle a while: closer, and the next try to get out waits

throw.push.note: the angel pushed down slowly, on purpose

wheel.spin.note: a spin of the Wheel of Hell

plea.early.note: begging again before the time is up

choice.silent.note: any answer of the silent tone, in any scene
